snippet.title: Megaman Zero: VS The Universe (Fangame Reveal Trailer)
snippet.description:
Download the demo now at:
https:// www.sagexpo.org
https:// sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/megaman-zero-vs-the-universe-sage2025-demo.2817


Megaman Zero VS The Universe is brought to you by ME(VanTrigger) and an anonymous co-dev who helped much on the custom art/vfx side. 
this is my first ever project working in game dev, been learning gamemaker and making the engine since late november of last year. was just kinda making a zero engine for the sake of it, had no real aim or proper fangame idea until only a couple months ago. considering this is my first, i think im doing decently so far. regardless, any and all feedback is appreciated

if youre interested in seeing updates just sub here and ill post the major stuff, or follow me on twitter at  @ DevTrigger1 , where ill probably put more teasers and stuff. im planning to add many more fights over time so, keep an eye out. hopefully if things go well the next demo should be in -december- -February. hopefully. maybe.- idk man itll be ready when its ready ToT


song used: Re-boot (mmz/zx legacy collection)
